text:
alex: heads up — seeing a weird cost blip and strange signal crosstalk between regions. cost dashboard shows a 40% GPU egress increase in eu-west over the last 3h while eu-west queue_depth is flat and us-east queue_depth spikes.

maria: ops-bot fired a `fleet-cost-spike` alert ~2h ago. logs show a bunch of small batches getting retried.

ops-bot: Alert: `fleet-cost-spike` (severity: medium) triggered at 1725549200. Metrics: gpu_egress_bytes_total +42% (3h), queue_depth{region="eu-west"} -5%, queue_depth{region="us-east"} +28%.

sam: could be rebalancer or regional spillover. rebalancer tends to move work and create transient small batches which blow up token egress because of KV-cache misses.

jin: agree. quick correlator queries:
```
# per-region queue depth
sum(rate(requests_in_queue[5m])) by (region)

# small batch fraction
sum(rate(batch_size_bucket{le="8"}[5m])) / sum(rate(batch_size_count[5m]))

# egress bytes by region
sum(rate(gpu_egress_bytes_total[5m])) by (region)
```

maria: i ran the small-batch fraction query — eu-west has 61% small batches vs us-east 18%. that aligns with the high egress per token cost (small batches = more overhead + KV cold misses).

kevin: i also see tcp_retransmit_rate spikes on the eu-west proxy nodes around the same time — might be flaky network causing retries and batch fragmentation.

alex: so hypothesis: transient network flakiness in eu-west -> retries/fragmentation -> higher small-batch fraction -> more egress and cost. but why is us-east queue_depth spiking then?

sam: spillback. requests get routed away from eu-west when proxy latencies climb; us-east absorbs bursts causing queue buildup there. net effect: global egress grows and cost spikes.

jin: action items:
- add a Grafana panel that plots small_batch_fraction and gpu_egress_bytes side-by-side by region
- add an alert for small_batch_fraction > 50% sustained 10m
- instrument rebalancer with a `rebalance_events` counter annotated with `reason` label

maria: i'll add the panel and alert. quick panel query suggestion for Grafana transform:
```
A = sum(rate(batch_size_bucket{le="8"}[5m])) by (region)
B = sum(rate(batch_size_count[5m])) by (region)
expr = A / B
```

kevin: i'm going to triage proxy packet captures for eu-west and file a ticket with the cloud provider if I see infra-level packet drops.

alex: nice. can someone run a one-off job to warm KV cache for hot models in eu-west to see if that lowers egress? simple test: spin up a synthetic warmup runner hitting top-10 models for 30m.

sam: i'll run warmup tonight at 02:00 UTC (low traffic). will report results.

ops-bot: Note: added incidents/1725550000 to the incident tracker (severity: P2, labels: cost, networking, autoscale).

maria: created dashboard PR: https://grafana.company/redwood/d/xyz/fleet-small-batch-and-egress?orgId=1 — patch includes panel, 10m alert rule.

alex: perfect. if spikes continue after warmup and proxy fix, we'll page infra-oncall. thanks all :thumbsup:
